name: plans
description: Query and archive duya execution plans from the global plans directory (~/.duya/projects/<projectId>/plans): list active plans, search across projects, and move finished plans to completed.

interface.shortDescription: Query and archive duya execution plans
interface.longDescription: Exposes the duya plans store (~/.duya/projects/<projectId>/plans/) as three MCP tools: plan_status lists a project's active plans, plan_search finds plans across projects by keyword, and plan_complete archives a finished plan. Plan creation and content editing stay with the ordinary file tools.
